1.t: By the charging steeds that pant

2.t: and strike sparks with their hooves,

5.t: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,

6.t: man is ungrateful to his Lord––

7.t: and He is witness to this––

8.t: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.

9.t: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,

10.t: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,

11.t: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?
